memories.text: Climate and earth observation data come from NASA Earthdata and the Copernicus Climate Data Store.
Public health statistics are in the WHO Global Health Observatory and national disease registries.
Text datasets can be found on Hugging Face and in Common Crawl; check each licence before use.
Economic series are in FRED, Eurostat and the World Bank open data portal.
Astronomical observations are in the ESA archive and MAST.
Before reusing a dataset check its licence and cite its DOI.
A downloaded dataset used different units from its documentation; compare summary statistics and units right after download.

fields.situation: a freshly downloaded dataset gives odd magnitudes
fields.insight: the file's units differed from the documentation
fields.do_instead: check units and summary statistics after download

memories.text: Deposit your own datasets in Zenodo to get a DOI before the paper is submitted.
